routingRules: winwincode owns Community product code and the versioned neutral core published to downstream repositories
winwincode-cloud owns Hosted multi-tenant identity, billing, cloud workers, object storage and operator-run SaaS operations
winwincode-enterprise owns customer-private identity, organization access, policy, audit, deployment, backup, upgrade and customer-managed workers
cross-repository-migration is a temporary task owner, not a fourth Git repository
an implementation task has exactly one owner; similar Cloud and Enterprise concepts become separately scoped product tasks rather than copied tasks
Cloud and Enterprise consume an exact Community core release and checksum; no cross-repository source path dependency is allowed
Community and Codex kernel SQLite remain; only Cloud and Enterprise product backends use PostgreSQL

crossRepositoryPrerequisites.requiredOutcome: Publish a versioned neutral core inventory, packages, schemas, SBOM, licenses and SHA-256 checksums from winwincode.
Create independent Git, Beads and CI roots before creating product backlog entries.
Each downstream repository pins one exact core version and checksum; mismatches fail the build.
Replace the old generic backend migration with distinct Cloud multi-tenant and Enterprise customer-private PostgreSQL scopes. Keep Codex kernel and Device SQLite.
Create each mapped task once in its owner repository, preserve source provenance, then supersede the temporary source record.
Remove Cloud and Enterprise product code from winwincode only after target acceptance, then run each repository independent release gate.

productSemanticSplits.rule: Cloud owns Hosted tenant accounts and isolation; Enterprise owns customer identity providers, directories, device policy and customer data rules.
Cloud owns Hosted object storage, multi-instance coordination and regional operation; Enterprise owns customer-controlled backup and export. Generic transition tasks only freeze boundaries.
Cloud abuse and tenant isolation controls are operator runtime work; Enterprise supply-chain checks are private release work.

preMigrationCollisionReview.requiredResolution: Separate already-started facade work from the rewritten remaining facade scope, then keep one canonical active task.
Separate already-started occupancy controls from remaining rewritten UI scope, then keep one canonical active task.
Split credential issuance from launch-loop wiring with non-overlapping acceptance criteria before repository migration.
